notes: Commodity baskets for the Food Origins explorer (spec §6.1). Each basket is the set of CN8 codes that HMRC's /Commodity endpoint lists under the given HS headings, including codes no longer in use, so the series is continuous across nomenclature changes. Five baskets verified against /Commodity on 23 Oct 2026; the other eleven added 26 Oct 2026 (John), checked against /Commodity and Defra's trade codes (gate G3) in the data step (docs/03-DATA-SOURCES.md, S01, S05). Groups follow the SITC divisions Defra uses (05 vegetables and fruit, 04 cereals, 01 meat, 02 dairy, 06 sugars and 07 coffee and cocoa).

baskets.label: Tomatoes
baskets.definition: Tomatoes, fresh or chilled (HS 0702). Excludes processed tomatoes.

baskets.label: Potatoes
baskets.definition: Potatoes, fresh or chilled, including seed potatoes (HS 0701). Excludes frozen and processed potatoes.

baskets.label: Apples
baskets.definition: Apples, fresh (HS 0808 10), including cider apples in bulk. Excludes dried, frozen and processed apples.

baskets.label: Oranges
baskets.definition: Oranges, fresh or dried (HS 0805 10). Excludes mandarins and other citrus, and orange juice.

baskets.label: Bananas
baskets.definition: Bananas including plantains, fresh or dried (HS 0803).

baskets.label: Wheat
baskets.definition: Wheat and meslin, including durum wheat and seed for sowing (HS 1001). Excludes flour.

baskets.label: Rice
baskets.definition: Rice at every stage (HS 1006): in the husk, husked (brown), semi-milled or wholly milled, and broken. Excludes rice flour.

baskets.label: Beef and veal
baskets.definition: Meat of bovine animals, fresh, chilled or frozen (HS 0201, 0202). Excludes offal, and processed or preserved beef.

baskets.label: Sheep and goat meat
baskets.definition: Lamb and mutton (HS 0204 10–0204 43) and goat meat (HS 0204 50), fresh, chilled or frozen. Apart from lamb carcases and some frozen lamb, the codes record sheep meat without separating lamb from mutton. Excludes offal and processed meat.

baskets.label: Poultry meat
baskets.definition: Meat and edible offal of poultry (fowls, turkeys, ducks, geese, guinea fowls), fresh, chilled or frozen (HS 0207). Excludes processed and preserved poultry.

baskets.label: Milk products (not cheese)
baskets.definition: Milk and cream, concentrated and powdered milk, yoghurt, buttermilk, whey and butter (HS 0401–0405). Excludes cheese, which is a separate basket. Net mass adds products as recorded (liquid milk, powders, butter), not converted to a milk equivalent.

baskets.label: Sugar
baskets.definition: Cane or beet sugar and chemically pure sucrose, in solid form, raw or refined (HS 1701). Excludes molasses and sugar confectionery.

baskets.label: Coffee
baskets.definition: Coffee, roasted or not, decaffeinated or not; coffee husks and skins; substitutes containing coffee (HS 0901). Excludes instant coffee, extracts and essences (HS 2101).

baskets.label: Cocoa
baskets.definition: Cocoa beans, cocoa paste, cocoa butter and cocoa powder (HS 1801, 1803–1805). Excludes cocoa shells (1802) and chocolate (1806). Net mass adds beans and products as recorded, not converted to a bean equivalent.
